relationships.subject: Diclofenac-loaded hydrogel
relationships.evidence_quote: anti-inflammatory activity of the hydrogels was carried out by gene expression study in RAW 264.7 cells, which indicate the downregulation of several key inflammatory genes such as COX-2, TNF-α & 18s

key_findings: NSAID-loaded ECM-mimetic hydrogel shows anti-inflammatory activity in macrophages in vitro.
